```{python}
#| label: fig-polygon-holes-and-strips
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "A triangular shield leaves a hole in the target. Vertical strips pair the filled boundary crossings, so the hole contributes no fringe. The dashed lines mark decomposition boundaries, not new conductors."
#| fig-alt: "Two panels show a rectangular target with a triangular shield, then the same visible target partitioned at the triangle's left and right vertices. In the middle strip, upper and lower filled intervals surround the empty triangular hole."
import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path
import drawsvg as dw
project_root = Path(os.environ.get('QUARTO_PROJECT_ROOT', '.')).resolve()
sys.path.insert(0, str(project_root / 'figures'))
from polygon_diagram_helpers import INK, SOURCE, TARGET, SHIELD, ACCENT, label, arrow, polygon
d=dw.Drawing(880,400)
d.append(dw.Rectangle(0,0,880,400,fill='white'))
for left,title in ((40,'Subtract the projected shield'),(480,'Partition the remaining target')):
    label(d,title,left,30,size=20)
    polygon(d,[(left,80),(left+320,80),(left+320,320),(left,320)],TARGET,TARGET)
    hole=[(left+80,280),(left+240,200),(left+240,280)]
    polygon(d,hole,'white',SHIELD,1.0)
    d.append(dw.Line(left,350,left+320,350,stroke=SOURCE,stroke_width=4))
    label(d,'Source edge',left+160,380,color=SOURCE,anchor='middle')
label(d,'Target',65,113,color=TARGET)
label(d,'Shield',204,267,color=SHIELD)
label(d,'Target',738,113,size=17,color=TARGET)
label(d,'Hole',665,267,color=SHIELD)
for x in (560,720):
    d.append(dw.Line(x,65,x,332,stroke=ACCENT,stroke_dasharray='5,4',stroke_width=1.5))
label(d,'x₁',560,58,color=ACCENT,anchor='middle')
label(d,'x₂',720,58,color=ACCENT,anchor='middle')
arrow(d,625,83,625,244,both=True,color=INK)
arrow(d,625,284,625,317,both=True,color=INK)
label(d,'Filled',646,164,size=17)
label(d,'Filled',646,309,size=17)
arrow(d,385,200,450,200,color=INK,width=2.5)
d
```
